# pptx test fixtures

`01_standard_business.pptx` and `05_unicode_cjk_emoji.pptx` were generated
with [python-pptx](https://github.com/scanny/python-pptx) (MIT License,
copyright Steve Canny) and derive their slide master / layouts / theme from
python-pptx's built-in default template. The MIT permission notice those
parts are distributed under is in `LICENSE-python-pptx.txt` next to this
file. Slide text content is synthetic test data authored for this repository.

## 06_corpus_gaps.pptx

Our own content, made from scratch by `tools/pptx-diff/make-fixture.ts`; no
third-party deck, image, model or font is in it. Rerun from the repository
root with Node 22:

```
node node_modules/tsx/dist/cli.mjs tools/pptx-diff/make-fixture.ts
```

The generator starts from the engine's blank deck (`createBlankPptx`), writes
every fragment with the engine's own writers where one exists (`buildSpXml`,
`buildTableXml`, `buildGrpSpXml`, `custGeomXml`, `model3dXml`,
`buildChartSpaceXml`, `chartWorkbookXlsx`, `setRedactExt`,
`ensureTableStyleXml`, `buildTimingXml`, `creationIdXml`) and mirrors the
engine's insert paths for parts, relationships and content types. The PNGs
and the `.glb` (a tetrahedron) are generated by the script. The output is
deterministic: fixed UUIDs, fixed zip dates, no clock and no randomness, so a
rerun gives the same bytes.

It exists for the parity gate's corpus comparison (`tools/pptx-diff`), which
runs every ported function on the tracked decks: the other fixtures hold none
of these kinds, so the functions that read them got no real-document input.
One slide per kind:

1. Custom geometry: six `a:custGeom` shapes with `a:avLst`/`a:gdLst` guides
   (chained, most formula kinds), `moveTo`, `lnTo`, `arcTo`, `quadBezTo`,
   `cubicBezTo`, `close`, several paths with their own `w`/`h`,
   `fill="none"` and `stroke="0"`.
2. A 3D model: a `.glb` behind the `mc:AlternateContent` PowerPoint writes,
   with its fallback picture.
3. Durable ids: `a16:creationId` on shapes, a picture and group children.
4. Groups: a group with a scaled child space holding a shape, a picture and
   a nested group.
5. Redaction marks: two marked runs (one beside another `a:extLst`
   extension) and a marked picture.
6. A bar chart with string and number caches and its embedded workbook.
7. Tables: the built-in Medium Style 2 - Accent 1 and a ribbon preset style,
   both defined in `ppt/tableStyles.xml`.
8. Animations: a timing tree with three effects.

It has no embedded font: embedding one needs an MTX encoder, which the
repository does not have.

SHA-256: `2b1d003223e47c8f534d940b12280bb767a4a720e06b1c386b8ed575c9cb2c69`

It was read back with this engine's `openPptx` and saved again with
`savePptx`, but it was NOT opened in PowerPoint.
